name: Chocolate Cookies
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Cream the butter, add sugar gradually, egg well beaten, salt, and chocolate melted.
Beat well, and add flour mixed and sifted with baking powder alternately with milk.
Chill, roll very thin, then shape with a small cutter, first dipped in flour, and bake in a moderate oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
